newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar emir reconciled with father he ousted - agency.
newsitem.headline: Qatar emir reconciled with father he ousted - agency.

text.p: Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani was reconciled on Friday with his father, whom he overthrew in a bloodless coup in 1995, the official Qatar News Agency said on Saturday.

The emir and his father, Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad al-Thani, met in Paris and they "agreed to end family differences between them and start a new page of family ties base on love and mutual respect and appreciation," the agency said.
The Emir met his father last month in Rome for the first time since he ousted him. Officials said the meeting was intended to pave the way for Sheikh Khalifa's return home.

They said at the time the former emir, who has been in self-imposed exile since his June 1995 ouster, would not return home immediately and that discussions continued on whether 200 of his followers would be allowed back.
Qatar has accused them of taking part in a foiled coup plot in February. The former emir has denied any involvement in the plot.

Qatari officials had said the former emir was expected to return following an agreement over billions of dollars discovered missing from state coffers after his removal. Unofficial estimates put the sum he controlled between $3 billion and $7 billion.
